_about: Ruined old Thalos (levels 9-45): lamiae haunt the temple grounds and help each other, their Matriarch a sub-boss; the stone golems of the watchtowers and the mimics in the ruins are elites; and the mighty beholder in the Temple of Thalos rakes the floor with disintegrating rays while its eye darkens the temple.
